mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an abrupt political change not within the contemplation of the Constitution."
A revolution is an abrupt political change not within the contemplation of the Constitution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an epitome of Islamic thought, a system of law in which legal rules, ethics, religion, rituals and politics are closely interwoven."
Islamic law is an epitome of Islamic thought, a system of law in which legal rules, ethics, religion, rituals and politics are closely interwoven.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the art or process of explaining and expounding the intended significance of the language used in the written law; that is the meaning, which the lawmakers designed it to convey to the public."

Interpretation is the art or process of explaining and expounding the intended significance of the language used in the written law; that is the meaning, which the lawmakers designed it to convey to the public.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means any law made by the National Assembly and includes any law, which takes effect under the provisions of the Constitution as an Act of the National Assembly."
Act of National Assembly means any law made by the National Assembly and includes any law, which takes effect under the provisions of the Constitution as an Act of the National Assembly.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a recognized institution of society with defined function of defending the national integrity."
The military is a recognized institution of society with defined function of defending the national integrity.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the branch of governance invested with judicial powers, the system of Courts, the body of judges, the Bench, that branch of government, which is intended to interpret, construe and apply the law."

Judiciary is the branch of governance invested with judicial powers, the system of Courts, the body of judges, the Bench, that branch of government, which is intended to interpret, construe and apply the law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Quran and Sunnah, the Wahy al Jah (the revelation per se), Wahy al Khafi (the hidden revelation) etc."
The fountain head is the Quran and Sunnah, the Wahy al Jah (the revelation per se), Wahy al Khafi (the hidden revelation) etc.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with law as it is; not law as it ought to be."
The imperative Theory of law is concerned with law as it is; not law as it ought to be.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an unlawful sexual intercourse of a female without her consent."
Rape is an unlawful sexual intercourse of a female without her consent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of interpreting or explaining the sense or intention of a writing, usually a Statute."
Judicial Construction is the process of interpreting or explaining the sense or intention of a writing, usually a Statute.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means "one is known to ones companies"."
Noscitur a sociis means "one is known to ones companies".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means "to stand by things decided" or keep to the rationes decidendi of past cases."
Stare decisis means "to stand by things decided" or keep to the rationes decidendi of past cases.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the materials that are outside the statute, which the courts may consult in the course of construing and interpreting the statute."
External aids refer to the materials that are outside the statute, which the courts may consult in the course of construing and interpreting the statute.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a moral being endowed with concepts of what is right or wrong."
Man is a moral being endowed with concepts of what is right or wrong.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is derived from a Latin word 'sancio' meaning, "to ordain, confirm or forbid under penalty"."
Sanction is derived from a Latin word 'sancio' meaning, "to ordain, confirm or forbid under penalty".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a law passed by a legislative body."
Statute is a law passed by a legislative body.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an integral part of that received English law and is the subject of this lecture."
The Common Law is an integral part of that received English law and is the subject of this lecture.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the consensus idea of Ulama and Qiyas functioning as an integrated structure whose adherents agree on the norms, rules, and values which are to be uniformly respected and observed."
Al Ijma is the consensus idea of Ulama and Qiyas functioning as an integrated structure whose adherents agree on the norms, rules, and values which are to be uniformly respected and observed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a generally accepted rule or practice, usage or custom, which has become binding."
A Convention is a generally accepted rule or practice, usage or custom, which has become binding.
